name: Paula Passgenau
personality: She distributes opportunities with the calm of someone who owns the queue.
visual_intent: Slim comma-shaped upright blob with modest quiff/lashes, one sharply raised eyelid, toothless cool smirk; teal headband and small ochre-edged jersey bib; one hand directs, other balances a brown leather basketball at waist
biography: She distributes opportunities with the calm of someone who owns the queue. Her corridor team routes opportunities through a single approved distributor. She can turn a basketball into a diagram of who deserves a turn. A dissonant card about unrequested generosity has made her pass to the resident nobody drafted. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie verteilt Chancen. Die Warteliste ist erstaunlich persönlich.

name: Egon Eigenwurf
personality: He has never met a shot he considered somebody else's responsibility.
visual_intent: Round star-lobed blob with high uneven eyes and deliriously proud open grin, two upper teeth; tiny teal jersey bib, holds both empty goo hands in an exaggerated delicate follow-through near his face
biography: He has never met a shot he considered somebody else's responsibility. He treats the courtyard hoop as a public referendum on himself. His follow-through lasts long enough for somebody else to retrieve the ball. When the building labels a neighbour a permanent miss, he begins practising the unfamiliar gesture of an assist. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Wurf war richtig. Das Ergebnis hat sich nicht daran gehalten.

name: Willi Wechselwinkel
personality: He adapts beautifully to situations that have already ended.
visual_intent: Tall bent pear splat, worried crooked brow, tiny closed sideways mouth; ochre sweatband slightly slipping, small teal collar; holds a folded towel shaped into a simple unexpected triangle
biography: He adapts beautifully to situations that have already ended. He is reassigned whenever the building changes its definition of useful. The triangular towel is folded to meet three incompatible instructions. A card without a designated position has given him a small, alarming hope that adaptability need not mean disappearance. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Er kann überall eingesetzt werden. Anwesenheit wird gesondert geprüft.

name: Greta Gegenbrett
personality: She calls every rebound a recoverable household asset.
visual_intent: Broad square-lobed blob, two filled thick eyelids with lashes, stubborn closed frown; ochre neck trim and small teal jersey panel; hugs a scuffed brown basketball tightly as if it were the last hot-water bottle
biography: She calls every rebound a recoverable household asset. She retrieves anything the league declares a lost cause and calls it stock recovery. Her basketball is held like a vulnerable household appliance. The residents considered too difficult to pass to have quietly become her most dependable neighbours. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie holt die zweiten Chancen. Die erste war bereits abgeschrieben.

name: Otto Oberkante
personality: He is the tallest person in the room and apologises for the view.
visual_intent: Very tall slender rounded ink tower with drooping crest yet fits cell; huge bashful white eyes, small astonished mouth with no visible teeth; tiny teal collar, one old canvas high-top shoe held in a goo hand as lucky charm, no legs or feet
biography: He is the tallest person in the room and apologises for the view. His height makes him responsible for every problem stored above eye level. The canvas shoe is a reminder that fitting a role is not the same as fitting equipment. A dissonant card persuaded him to lower the notices for shorter residents. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Er hat Übersicht. Entschuldigung dafür.

name: Bert Bankreserve
personality: He has perfected the warm-up for an opportunity that remains administratively pending.
visual_intent: Wide flattened but upright blob, deeply unimpressed half-lidded stare, compressed long mouth; old teal warm-up jacket as SMALL open shoulder cape, holds one squat thermos and a single folded towel on shoulder
biography: He has perfected the warm-up for an opportunity that remains administratively pending. He warms the building's reserve bench while official enthusiasm is being allocated. The thermos contains enough tea for people who were not selected. He still sorts residents into starters and substitutes, but his cups no longer follow that rule. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist jederzeit bereit. Das jederzeit wurde mehrfach verschoben.
